shared_visual_core.material: Subtle SVG displacement gives a controlled hand-drawn edge without moving geometry
shared_visual_core.shape_and_line: Thin persistent frames, simple Lucide line icons and straight or orthogonal routes
shared_visual_core.image_treatment: All explanatory structure is native SVG; the confirmed original author uses a local project-owned avatar
shared_visual_core.hierarchy_and_rhythm: The full system map is readable from frame one; route-colored dots reveal one semantic event at a time

time_motion.carrier: Three route-colored dots and short trails move only along fixed paths
time_motion.states: Overview, trigger, invocation, tool execution, human branch, feedback, automatic branch, shared-state read/write and hold
time_motion.invariants: Text, node geometry, path geometry, line width, border color and border brightness remain unchanged throughout
time_motion.loop: repeat after a stable final hold
time_motion.delivery: The same deterministic browser timeline produces source screenshots and an H.264 yuv420p mobile-compatible MP4
